objective: V4.3 Retrieval and Query Control — interpret queries, infer lanes, tune scoring by query mode, and enforce bounded spark retrieval before context/chat work.
context: V4.2 extends ingest and schema. spark_retrieval.py already provides deterministic hybrid scoring and optional lane filter, but callers must pass lane manually and depth limits allow 32+ sparks. V4.3 adds query intelligence without chat wiring.
decisions: Keep weighted hybrid scoring; add query-mode profiles instead of rigid global sort order.
Domain/lane filter runs before scoring when lanes are inferred or passed.
Retrieval remains deterministic code; LLM used only for optional lane hint with rule fallback.
Hard cap 15 sparks for default retrieval profile.
Lane inference may return multiple primary lanes for genuinely cross-domain queries; explicit lane param still overrides inference.
non_goals: Changing canonical score constants without query-mode wrapper
risks: Auto lane inference misroutes cross-domain queries
Over-tight cap hides relevant supporting context
Query-mode heuristics regress existing spark_retrieval tests
qa_expectations: Per ticket: focused tests in tests/test_cognitive_query.py and tests/test_spark_retrieval.py extensions. Full suite at T5.
next_action: Do not claim until V4.2 T6 doc-locked.

approval.note: V4.3 second ladder per cognitive completion plan.

tickets.title: V4.3 T1: cognitive query interpreter
tickets.description: Add cognitive_query.py classifying query intent: recall, decision, reflection, planning. Expose interpret_query(q) -> {mode, hints}. Use rules + keywords first; optional light model only when rules tie. Integrate into spark_retrieval entrypoint and GET /api/cognitive/context as optional auto mode. Files: cognitive_query.py, spark_retrieval.py, context_orchestration.py, tests/test_cognitive_query.py. Depends on V4.2 complete.
acceptance: interpret_query returns one of recall|decision|reflection|planning
Rule fixtures classify without model call in CROWLEY_TEST_MODE
context orchestration records query mode in trace when debug=1
tests/test_cognitive_query.py covers all four modes with fixtures
interpret_query may include inferred_lanes as a list, not only one lane

tickets.title: V4.3 T2: auto lane inference and pre-score filtering
tickets.description: Infer one or more primary lanes from query text using DOMAIN_ALIASES + keyword maps; apply lane filter before candidate pool scoring in spark_retrieval.py. Support explicit ?lane= override. Allow secondary_lanes_json matches as lower-weight inclusion, not filter bypass. Files: cognitive_query.py, spark_retrieval.py, sparks.py, tests/test_spark_retrieval.py. Depends on V4.3 T1.
acceptance: Query mentioning only money/finance filters to money lane before scoring
Cross-domain query mentioning money and health keeps both inferred lanes instead of over-filtering to one
Explicit lane param overrides inference
Secondary lane match boosts score but does not bypass primary filter
Retrieval tests prove filter-before-score ordering
No regression on existing lane filter tests

tickets.title: V4.3 T3: query-mode scoring profiles
tickets.description: Add scoring profiles keyed by query mode that shift weights among semantic, confidence, recency, graph components and certainty/trust_state boosts (confirmed > tentative, active > inactive). Default profile preserves current 0.40/0.25/0.15/0.20 behavior for recall mode. Files: spark_retrieval.py, spark_lifecycle.py, tests/test_spark_retrieval.py. Depends on V4.3 T1.
acceptance: recall profile matches legacy scores on fixed fixture set
planning profile boosts recency and decision spark_type when present
confirmed certainty ranks above tentative at equal semantic score
score_breakdown documents profile and boosts
Retrieval regression suite passes

tickets.title: V4.3 T4: enforce 8-15 spark retrieval cap
tickets.description: Align context_resolution.py COGNITIVE_DEPTH_LIMITS and spark_retrieval default limits so default API/chat-oriented profile returns 8-15 sparks total (core+supporting), never silent overflow. Deep mode may request more only with explicit depth=deep. Update trace to report truncated_count. Files: context_resolution.py, spark_retrieval.py, context_orchestration.py, tests/test_cognitive_context.py. Depends on V4.3 T3.
acceptance: Default medium depth returns <=15 sparks combined
Trace includes truncated_count when pool exceeds cap
deep depth allows higher limits with explicit param only
Existing cognitive context tests updated and pass
